recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio portrait of a figure wearing a matte black motorcycle helmet, set against a stark white void. The composition is bisected by a vibrant, fuzzy-edged red spray-paint graphic that wraps around the subject's torso in a gestural, butterfly-like symmetry.
coreVisualRelationships: The matte black helmet anchors the top of the vertical axis against the white background.
The saturated red spray paint provides a tactile, chaotic contrast to the clean photographic subject.
Dynamic hair movement creates a horizontal counter-balance to the vertical pose.
The sharp white nails echo the brightness of the background, creating visual punctures in the mid-ground.
coreInvariants: Pure white background with minimal floor shadow
High-key lighting with soft skin transitions

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centrally aligned, full-body vertical orientation occupying approximately 70% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, heavy mass of the motorcycle helmet at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the helmet, follow the torso down to the red graphic, then move outward along the spray-paint wings and flowing hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space surrounding the subject to emphasize the silhouette and color pops.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between black and white, with high-saturation red acting as the sole chromatic element.
paletteRestrictions: No mid-tone grays in the background
Limited to Black, White, Red, and natural skin tones

letterConstructionRules: Simulated spray-paint nozzle effect with soft, diffused edges
Variable line weight based on hand-speed simulation
Symmetrical mirrored layout across the central axis
Intentional overspray and 'dusting' around the main strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are abstracted into wing-like or flame-like shapes
Sharp terminals that bleed into the white background
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pairing raw, hand-drawn graffiti with clean, industrial photography.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the raw, street-art energy of the original
The sharp, rhythmic peaks of the lettering suggest this influence

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast studio photograph of a person in a matte black motorcycle helmet against a pure white background, with hair blowing to the side and high-key lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a symmetrical, bright red spray-paint graphic across the center of the image using a soft-edged brush with aerosol grain texture.

verificationChecks: Does the red graphic have a fuzzy, spray-painted edge?
Is the helmet matte black without excessive reflections?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the spray paint grain
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red graphic appears to 'wrap' the subject.
Verify the hair movement looks natural and dynamic.
Check that the helmet remains the primary visual anchor.
Confirm the white background is free of digital artifacts.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Photography + Industrial Gear + Symmetrical Aerosol Overlay + Primary Color Accent
